resources.string:
Prepare at home

Pair this device with your PC on your home network and confirm a normal stream works. Keep the PC awake and the host running.

Remote Wake-on-LAN needs a compatible router or an always-on device at home; this device cannot wake an unreachable PC by itself.

Connect your devices

A private VPN such as Tailscale can connect this device and your PC without exposing the host’s web UI to the Internet. Install it on both devices, sign into your own account and enable their connection. Existing VPN setups can also be used.

The link opens the official download guide. This app does not install software, create accounts, change router settings or enable port forwarding.

Verify from another network

Add the PC’s VPN address using Add address, with its streaming HTTP port if customized. This updates the saved PC when its identity matches. Return here afterward.

Disconnect this device from your home Wi-Fi and connect it to another network, such as a mobile hotspot. Test checks the paired PC’s identity and five small HTTPS requests; it does not start a stream or download a speed-test file. A test at home alone does not prove Internet reachability.
